findings.prior: HIGH weekday Areshet repeat cannot be switched off
findings.evidence: machzor_expanded-opensiddur-he/index.xml:3749-3784. The condition is now any(frankfurt_am_main=true, all(shabbat=true, musaf-shabbat-responses=both_cantor_repeat), all(shabbat=false, musaf-areshet-cantor-repeat=true)). compile-qa-v3/expanded-weekday_repeat_no.yaml:36-43 sets shabbat=false, frankfurt_am_main=false, metz=false and musaf-areshet-cantor-repeat=false. Nothing relies on a default. In expanded-weekday_repeat_no-print.xml:1974-2057 the order is: קהל Hayom, חזן Hayom, קהל Areshet, end of body. There is no reader Areshet and no j:conditional wrapper. expanded-weekday_repeat_yes-print.xml:2028-2084 is the same, plus exactly one חזן Areshet, also with no wrapper. In both outputs Areshet reads 'לְקוֹל תְּרוּעָתֵנוּ' with no זִכְרוֹן, and the conclusion reads 'מְקַדֵּשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל'. Both are correct for a weekday.

findings.prior: Hayom-only cantor repeat must be tied to Shabbat
findings.evidence: index.xml:3679-3695 is all(shabbat=true, hayom_only, musaf-hayom-only-cantor-repeat=true). The both_cantor_hayom and both_cantor_repeat branches are each gated on shabbat=true (3655-3678). expanded-shabbat_hayom_only_repeat_no-print.xml:2083-2113 gives one קהל Hayom, no Areshet, no wrapper. The _yes output (2085-2140) gives קהל Hayom and חזן Hayom, no Areshet, no wrapper. This matches s274 ויש שאומרים היום אבל לא ארשת. The outer inclusion conditions (3600-3630, 3711-3738) still have symbol branches that are not gated on shabbat. I checked this and it is logically sound: in each case the shabbat=false branch gives the same result (true). An undecided Shabbat state therefore can only wrongly resolve when the outcome would be the same either way. omit_both and hayom_only still leave Areshet undecided when Shabbat is unknown, which is correct.

findings.prior: Undecided region must still show the alternatives
findings.evidence: expanded-unknown.yaml declares nothing. expanded-unknown-print.xml:3340-3404 keeps section_musaf_areshet_cantor_repeat as a j:conditional around the חזן Areshet, with the HE/EN rubric. Within Areshet it also keeps the de-Hebr 'אַם שַׁבָּת.' זִכְרוֹן segment. Both inclusion and repeat endConditionals are present.

findings.problem: The 'weekday' profile declares only shabbat=false. Its rite and practice blocks are empty. Its output therefore correctly keeps the Areshet cantor repeat as a labeled conditional (2069-2104). assertions.json still lists it among the definite profiles with Areshet count 2, so the count mixes resolved and wrapped occurrences. This is not a data defect. The genuinely definite weekday cases are weekday_repeat_yes and weekday_repeat_no, and both are correct. The QA claim of '11 definite profiles' is slightly overstated: 10 are fully definite for these gates, and 'weekday' is partly definite.
findings.required_change: Optional, QA tooling only. Either rename the profile (e.g. weekday_region_unknown) or make the assertion counts report resolved and conditional occurrences separately. No change to the data.
